name: Kaidou Miho
source:
One of the original participants.

She is an excellent lawyer who isn't easily defeated. Rational and level-headed, others have noted that she has taken cases that everyone else was too afraid to take.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Miho_Kaidou]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
